posts.name: Nepycros
posts.cooked:
I got her. After losing against Iron Legacy, I fought against The Chairman in Rook City. The game was fairly average. I had Haka and Visionary out to control the Chairman's plays and make sure he never had too many good Jailbreaks.

 

After a while, I thought about it, and I realized I wanted to have WRAITH incap Operative. I didn't manage to get it done with Combat Stance, but a Throat Jab took her down. Afterwards, I focused fire until I used one final Inventory Barrage on Pike himself, ending the game and immediately getting the variant. Wraith had 6 HP at the end of the game.

 

I didn't get a screenshot of the actual variant unlock, sadly enough. Best I can do is show off her snazzy bio page.
